nodes.label: Unified local PC laboratory vision
nodes.rationale: Replace scattered HWiNFO+GPU-Z+OCCT+CrystalDiskMark+OpenRGB+Afterburner workflow with one probe, dashboard, BYOK AI advisor, and safety-bounded OC.

nodes.label: Local-first principle
nodes.rationale: All probe, benchmark, stress, monitor, RGB, and report data stays on the user's PC.

nodes.label: Safety-first OC (Vakhsh)
nodes.rationale: Reversible OS-level tuning only; BIOS/voltage/XMP advisory never silent apply; thermal gates and baseline rollback.

nodes.label: Hardware Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Build CPU→chipset→RAM→GPU→PSU→thermal path graph so AI queries structured graph not raw JSON dumps.

nodes.label: AI advisor pipeline
nodes.rationale: 100% local analysis first; AI is narration layer only with structured JSON; TOON context pack to cut tokens.

nodes.label: Tauri desktop target stack (master plan)
nodes.rationale: Prefer Tauri over pure Flutter for OSS launch to reuse web CSS/JS, Rust credibility, smaller binary; agent stays separate for elevation and crash isolation.
